BAD
NEUTRAL
JP
MULTI1

properties.comment: This is the house number (enum). This is a unique identification number for the house.

properties.name: Color
properties.valid_values:
GOOD
BRIGHT_GOOD
BAD
BRIGHT_BAD
NEUTRAL
BRIGHT_NEUTRAL
properties.comment: Each house is assigned a unique identification color to be used on the radar map and other color significant areas.

properties.name: BrightColor
properties.comment: The bright color for the house.

properties.name: RemapColorEnabled
properties.comment: Flag indicating whether remap color is enabled.

properties.name: RemapColor
properties.valid_values:
NONE
GOLD
LTBLUE
RED
GREEN
ORANGE
BLUE
properties.comment: This points to the default remap table for this house.

properties.name: RemapColor
properties.valid_values:
NONE
GOLD
LTBLUE
RED
GREEN
ORANGE
BLUE
properties.comment: This points to the default remap table for this house.

properties.name: Prefix
properties.comment: This is a unique ASCII character used when constructing filenames. It serves a similar purpose as the "Suffix" element, but is only one character long.

properties.name: Suffix
properties.comment: This is the filename suffix to use when creating a house specific file name. It is three characters long.
